58500.meaning1: armed with a quiver of arrows

examples.text: dvīhatīhapayāto kho pana so sattho addasa purisaṃ kāḷaṃ lohit'akkhaṃ sannaddhakalāpaṃ kumudamāliṃ allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ kaddamamakkhitehi cakkehi bhadrena rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchantaṃ, disvā etadavoca, kuto, bho, āgacchasī'ti? amukamhā janapadā'ti.

58501.meaning1: (of a bird's wings) stooping; folding in; tucking in (to swoop)
58501.commentary: (SNa) sannayhā'ti khurappaṃ sannayhamāno viya sannayhitvā suṭṭhu ṭhapetvā.

examples.text: atha kho sā, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale asaṃvadamānā ubho pakkhe sannayha lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā. yadā kho, bhikkhave, aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahuāgato kho my'āyaṃ sakuṇagghī'ti, atha tass'eva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi.
tassa rājā okkāko, ko n'evaṃ re ayaṃ mayhaṃ dāsiputto samāno maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yācatī'ti, kupito anattamano khurappaṃ sannayhi.
manussasaddo viya suyyati, jānissāma nan'ti sadd'ānusārena gantvā taṃ purisaṃ disvā, yakkho bhavissatī'ti bhītatasitā sare sannayhiṃsu

58504.meaning1: having armed; having equipped (with) for battle; having suited up for war

examples.text: assosi kho rājā pasenadi kosalo, rājā kira māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā mamaṃ abbhuyyāto yena kāsī'ti.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.

58506.commentary: (MNa) na sannāmetī'ti obaddhānābaddhaṭṭhānehi pādaṃ koṭṭento viya na thaddhaṃ karoti.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.
so antaragharaṃ pavisanto na kāyaṃ unnāmeti, na kāyaṃ onāmeti, na kāyaṃ sannāmeti, na kāyaṃ vināmeti.

58507.commentary: (MNa) na sannāmetī'ti obaddhānābaddhaṭṭhānehi pādaṃ koṭṭento viya na thaddhaṃ karoti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, api nu so puriso itic'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti?

58508.meaning1: having bent; having twisted; having wriggled

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro daḷhehi varattehi bandhanehi baddho īsakaṃ'y'eva kāyaṃ sannāmetvā tāni bandhanāni saṃchinditvā saṃpadāletvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.

58509.meaning1: putting on armour; preparing for battle

examples.text: mam'eva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ, sabbaṃ idaṃ calam'iti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.

58511.meaning1: when putting on armour; at the time of preparing for battle
58511.commentary: (THa) tvaṃ pana aññesaṃ viya katvā sannāhakāle kilesamāre yujjhituṃ bhāvanāsannāhakāle nati vatvā paridevitena kiṃ payojanaṃ, idāni taṃ aññathā vattituṃ na dassāmī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: mam'eva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ, sabbaṃ idaṃ calam'iti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.

58515.meaning1: restrains oneself; controls oneself; hold oneself back

examples.text: kuddh'āhaṃ na pharusaṃ brūmi, na ca dhammāni kittaye, sanniggaṇhāmi attānaṃ, sampassaṃ attham'attano'ti.

58516.meaning1: hoard; pile; stockpile; cache; stash; accumulation (of)

examples.text: yesaṃ sannicayo n'atthi, ye pariññātabhojanā, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, gati tesaṃ durannayā.
passāmi loke sadhane manusse, laddhāna vittaṃ na dadanti mohā, luddhā dhanaṃ sannicayaṃ karonti, bhiyyo'va kāme abhipatthayanti.

58517.meaning1: become a hoard; made a stockpile (of)

examples.text: sutasannicayo'ti sutassa sannicayabhūto. yathā hi sutaṃ hadayamañjūsāya sannicitaṃ silāyaṃ lekhā viya, suvaṇṇaghaṭe pakkhittasīhavasā viya ca ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ sutasannicayo nāma. dhātā'ti ṭhitā paguṇā.
tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, lūkhasmiṃ hoti, n'ekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti papaṭikajātaṃ.
seyyathā'pi rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti
anāgate sannicchaye, tath'ātīte ciratane, kāladvaye'pi kavīhi, puresaddo payujjate'ti.
atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa bhagavato poṭṭhapādaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāsannitodakena sañjhabbharim'akaṃsu
bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.
annānam'atho pānānaṃ, khādanīyānaṃ atho'pi vatthānaṃ, laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirā, na ca parittase tāni alabhamāno.

58531.grammar: pp of sannidhiṃ karoti, comp vb

examples.text: yato kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā sannidhikārakaṃ sāliṃ upakkamiṃsu paribhuñjituṃ. atha kaṇo'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, thuso'pi taṇḍulaṃ pariyonandhi, lūnam'pi nappaṭivirūḷhaṃ, apadānaṃ paññāyittha, saṇḍasaṇḍā sālayo aṭṭhaṃsu.

58535.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sannidhikāraka
58535.commentary: (VINa) sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbānī'ti sannidhiṃ katvā nidahitvā paribhuñjitabbāni. (VIN 2.5.4.8) sannidhikārakaṃ nāma ajja paṭiggahitaṃ aparajju khāditaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni gilānānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisāyanīyāni bhesajjāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ, tāni paṭiggahetvā satt'āhaparamaṃ sannidhikārakaṃ paribhuñjitabbāni, taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu sannidhikārakaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.

58536.meaning1: using stored up goods; (or) storage and usage
58536.commentary: (DNa) sannidhikāraparibhogan'ti sannidhikatassa paribhogaṃ. tattha duvidhā kathā, vinayavasena ca sallekhavasena ca. vinayavasena tāva yaṃ kiñci annaṃ ajja paṭiggahitaṃ aparajju sannidhikārakaṃ hoti, tassa paribhoge pācittiyaṃ. attanā laddhaṃ pana sāmaṇerānaṃ datvā, tehi laddhaṃ ṭhapāpetvā dutiyadivase bhuñjituṃ vaṭṭati, sallekho pana na hoti.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ iti vā iti evarūpā sannidhikāraparibhogā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

58537.grammar: pr, pass of saṃ ni √dhā, intrans

examples.text: bindu cūḷāmaṇ'ākāro, niggahītan'ti vuccate, kevalass'āppayogattā, akāro sannidhīyate.

58538.meaning2: assembly; congregation; gathering; lit. falling down together

examples.text: ettāni cattāri vattāni sammajjanakaraṇ'ādīni saṅghasannipatato paṭhamaṃ kattabbatā, uposathassa uposathakammassa pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati. pubbakaraṇānī'ti akkhātāni.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, janapadakalyāṇī, janapadakalyāṇī'ti kho, bhikkhave, mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sabbe dāsakammakar'ādayo ahatavatthanivatthā gandhamāl'ādipaṭimaṇḍitā rājakule sannipatanti.
ettāni cattāri vattāni sammajjanakaraṇ'ādīni saṅghasannipatato paṭhamaṃ kattabbatā, uposathassa uposathakammassa pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati. pubbakaraṇānī'ti akkhātāni.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: padālatāya antarahitāya sannipatiṃsu. sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no padālatā'ti

58543.commentary: (UDa) sannisinnānan'ti nisajjanavasena saṅgamma nisinnānaṃ. sannipatitānan'ti tato tato āgantvā sannipatanavasena sannipatitānaṃ. atha vā buddh'āsanaṃ purato katvā satthu sammukhe viya ādaruppattiyā sakkaccaṃ nisīdanavasena sannisinnānaṃ, samān'ajjhāsayattā aññam'aññasmiṃ ajjh'āsayena suṭṭhu sammā ca nipatanavasena sannipatitānaṃ.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sannipatito, bhante, bhikkhusaṅgho. yassa dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti.
tena kho pana samayena rāj'antepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi
tiṇṇaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sannipātā gabbhass'āvakkanti hoti. idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca na utunī hoti, gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti, n'eva tāva gabbhass'āvakkanti hoti.

58545.meaning1: should be gathered together; should be assembled
58545.commentary: (VINa) sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabban'ti iminā chandadānaṃ paṭikkhipati. bhinnassa hi saṅghassa samaggakaraṇakāle tiṇ'avatthārakasamathe imasmiñ'ca pavāraṇāsaṅgahe'ti imesu tīsu ṭhānesu chandaṃ dātuṃ na vaṭṭati.

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
saṅghamajjhe nissajjitabbo. sabbeh'eva adhiṭṭhitapattaṃ gahetvā sannipatitabbaṃ. na lāmako patto adhiṭṭhātabbo, mah'agghaṃ pattaṃ gahessāmī'ti.

58546.meaning1: having gathered together; having assembled; having met

examples.text: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, vūpasametabbaṃ. sabbeh'eva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitabbaṃ, sannipatitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo.
padālatāya antarahitāya sannipatiṃsu. sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no padālatā'ti
tathāgato atīte buddhe… jātito'pi anussarati, nāmato'pi anussarati, gottato'pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato'pi anussarati, sāvakayugato'pi anussarati, sāvakasannipātato'pi anussarati
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni
vītataṇho anādāno, niruttipadakovido, akkharānaṃ sannipātaṃ, jaññā pubb'āparāni ca, sa ve antimasārīro mahāpañño, mahāpuriso'ti vuccati.
yā kho, bhikkhave, imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ saṅgati sannipāto samavāyo, ayaṃ vuccati cakkhusamphasso. cakkhusamphasso'pi anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī.
so evaṃ pajānāti, evañ'hi kira imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.

58550.meaning1: illness produced by combination of the three humours
58550.meaning2: union of the humours of the body

examples.text: pittaṃ semhañ'ca vāto ca, sannipātā utūni ca, visamaṃ opakkamikaṃ, kammavipākena aṭṭhamī'ti.
tiṇṇaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sannipātā gabbhass'āvakkanti hoti. idha mātāpitaro ca sannipatitā honti, mātā ca na utunī hoti, gandhabbo ca na paccupaṭṭhito hoti, n'eva tāva gabbhass'āvakkanti hoti.

58552.meaning1: gathering place; place of assembly; meeting point

examples.text: tattha tatra bhikkhavo'ti tasmiṃ sannipātaṭṭhāne bhikkhū.

58554.meaning1: gathering together a lot; meeting frequently
58554.meaning2: gathering together a lot; having many meetings
58554.commentary: (ANa) sannipātabahulā'ti hiyyo'pi purimadivasam'pi sannipat'amha, puna ajja kim'atthaṃ sannipatāmā'ti vosānamanāpajjanena sannipātabahulā.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni

58555.meaning1: having gathered together; having assembled; having convoked
58555.meaningLit: having caused to fall down together

58556.meaning1: resulting from combination of the three humours
58556.meaning2: resulting from the union of the humours
58556.construction:
saṃ + ni + √pat > pāt + *a + ika
sannipāta + ika
58556.commentary: (SNa) sannipātikānī'ti tiṇṇam'pi pitt'ādīnaṃ kopena samuṭṭhitāni. (NIDD1a) sannipātikā'ti vātapittasemhānaṃ sannipātena ekībhāvena uppannā.
58556.notes: (MW) sāṃnipātika complicated (esp. applied to a dangerous illness produced by a combined derangement of the three humours)

examples.text: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pittasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā semhasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā vātasamuṭṭhānā ābādhā sannipātikā ābādhā utupariṇāmajā ābādhā visamaparihārajā ābādhā opakkamikā ābādhā kammavipākajā ābādhā sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo'ti.

evaṃ, devā'ti kho, bhikkhave, so puriso tassa rañño paṭissutvā yāvatakā sāvatthiyā jacc'andhā te sabbe gahetvā yena so rājā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca, sannipātitā kho te, deva, yāvatakā sāvatthiyā jacc'andhā'ti.

58558.meaning1: unites; assembles; convokes; makes gather together

examples.text: tenah'ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī'ti.

58559.meaning1: having gathered together; having assembled; having convoked
58559.meaning2: having convoked, having called a meeting
58559.meaningLit: having caused to fall down together

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtakañ'ca vesālikañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi

58561.synonym: upanibha, upama, disa, nibha, paṭibhāga, patirūpaka, saṅkāsa, sadisa, sappaṭibhāga, sarikkhaka, sarūpa
58561.commentary: (DNa) tūlasannibhā'ti simbalitūlalatātūlasamānā, ayam'assa odātatāya upamā. (THa) makkaṭasannibhaṃ vanamakkaṭasadisaṃ (THa) taṃ me mudū hehiti tūlasannibhan'ti taṃ tiṇapaccattharaṇaṃ mudu sukhasamphassaṃ tūlasannibhaṃ tūlikasadisaṃ sayanaṃ me bhavissati.

examples.text: suyuttavādī dvipadānam'uttamo, mahābhisakko naradammasārathi, cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti, avītarāgena sudunnivārayaṃ.
vaṇṇo ca te kanakassa sannibho, uttattarūpo bhusa dassaneyyo, pallaṅkaseṭṭhe atule nisinnā, ekā tuvaṃ n'atthi ca tuyha sāmiko.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vassānaṃ pacchime māse saradasamaye kiṭṭhasambādhe gopālako gāvo rakkheyya. so tā gāvo tato tato daṇḍena ākoṭeyya paṭikoṭeyya sannirundheyya sannivāreyya.

58569.meaning2: having restrained, having blocked, having impeded

58572.meaning1: should be made to settle down; should be caused to calm down; should be made to subside
58572.meaningLit: to cause to be seated down together

examples.text: kathaṃ nu kho, āvuso, cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ? kathaṃ cittaṃ sannisādetabbaṃ? kathaṃ cittaṃ ekodi kātabbaṃ? kathaṃ cittaṃ samādahātabban'ti?

58573.meaning1: makes settle down; causes to calm down; makes subside

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tassā'y'eva kathāya pariyosāne, tasmiṃ'y'eva purimasmiṃ samādhinimitte ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi, yena sudaṃ niccakappaṃ viharāmī'ti.
so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi. taṃ kissa hetu? mā me cittaṃ ūhaññī'ti.
kāya nu'ttha, licchavī, eta'r'ahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā'ti

tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.
abhijānāmi kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, anekasataṃ khattiyaparisaṃ upasaṅkamitā. tatra'pi mayā sannisinnapubbañ'c'eva, sallapitapubbañ'ca, sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā.
pañc'āhikaṃ kho pana mayaṃ, bhante, sabbarattikaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdāma. evaṃ kho mayaṃ, bhante, appamattā ātāpino pahit'attā viharāmā'ti

etaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha. sannipatitānaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, dhammī vā kathā, ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phass'āyatanesu cittaṃ udujitaṃ hoti sudujitaṃ, ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.

so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. so hoti samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.

58580.meaning1: to settle down; to calm down

58581.meaning2: having settled, having subsided, having become quiet

58582.commentary: (SNa) sannisīvesū'ti yathā phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ upagantvā sannisinnesu vissamamānesu. ṭhitamajjh'anhikakālo nām'esa sabbasattānaṃ iriyāpathadubbalyakālo. idha pana pakkhīnaṃ'y'eva vasena dassito

examples.text: ṭhite majjh'anhike kāle, sannisīvesu pakkhisu, saṇat'eva brah'āraññaṃ, taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti man'ti.

58583.commentary: (NIDD1a) attabhāvasannissayā'ti attabhāvaṃ upanissāya ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppajjantī'ti attabhāvasannissayā.
